definitions.short: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan , a place in the Desert
definitions.usage: Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.
definitions.full: H885. Beeroth Bene-yaaqan בְּנֵייַֿעֲקָן בְּאֵרֹת proper name, of a location Deut 10:6 (compare Num 33:31-32 , where יעקן בני ), a station of Israel in desert, probably in country of Horites, compare Di.
definitions.rootNote: from the feminine plural of 875 , and the plural contraction of 1121 , and 3292 ; wells of (the) sons of Jaakan;

occurrences.englishText: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
